parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const q = v => v == null ? 'NULL' : "'" + String(v).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'"; const r = $('Return Report').first().json; const k = 'REPORT-' + r.asOfDate + '-LIVE'; return `WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO ops.report_delivery (idem_key, event, as_of_date, message_text, message_sha256) VALUES (${q(k)}, 'CLAIM', ${q(r.asOfDate)}::date, ${q(r.replyText)}, ${q(r.messageSha256)}) ON CONFLICT (idem_key, event) DO NOTHING RETURNING row_id) SELECT row_id FROM ins`; })() }}
